nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: Talk if you want. I've got four boxes to kill and Boss counting.

choices.text: How long have you done this?
Why's that alarm light still on?

nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: Long enough to know a bad one. This one's bad. Too easy. Nobody's easy.

nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: Someone inside. Boss's phone friend. Months of it. Times, doors, which guard drinks.

nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: Because the phone friend only cut the outside line. Said the alarm logs if you touch it. So I do the vault boxes first, then that. Then it's dead.

choices.text: Why's that alarm light still on?
Does your boss know who he is?

nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: Boss don't know him. Nobody knows him. That's the point of him.

nodes.speaker: Tarry
nodes.text: I said don't try anything funny. Corner. Hands where I can see them.
